'''Nimia''' was a [[Planet/Legends|planet]] located in the [[Hutt Space/Legends|Hutt Space]] between [[Klatooine/Legends|Klatooine]] and [[Yoribuunt]]. It was located near the [[Si'Klaata Cluster/Legends|Si'Klaata Cluster]]. A lackluster industrial world, Nimia was occasionally used as a meeting place between [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]] servants and [[outlander]]s who had failed to attract much favor with the Hutts.<ref name="TEA" />
